seoFaq.label: Frequently asked questions
seoFaq.title: Water well drilling and water supply — common questions

q1.q: Do you drill artesian wells in Tashkent and other regions of Uzbekistan?
q1.a: Yes. SUV-TARAQQIYOT LLC drills artesian and hydrogeological wells in 12 regions of Uzbekistan, including Tashkent city and region, Namangan, Samarkand, Kashkadarya and Syrdarya. Drilling depth is 30 to 1200 m, about 120 wells a year.

q2.q: What water pipeline diameters and materials do you install?
q2.a: We build transmission mains and distribution networks from 32 to 1200 mm in diameter in polyethylene (HDPE) and steel pipe — up to 200 km a year for municipal water supply and industrial sites.

q3.q: Do you deliver projects financed by the World Bank, the EBRD and the OPEC Fund?
q3.a: Yes. Projects in the register: Zhiydakapa water intake (NWP-6) — EBRD; Koshrabad District (W/3.1, W/4.1) — OPEC Fund and Saudi Fund for Development; Namangan City, Phase 2 (NWSP/ICB/W-4-2) — OPEC Fund; Yangiyul water supply (MSC-Y/W/1.2) — World Bank (IBRD Loan 8914-UZ), under FIDIC conditions.

history.p1: SUV-TARAQQIYOT LLC was founded in 2001 on the basis of NPO Wolfram. Every year the company carries out contract work on water supply systems: water pipelines, water intake and distribution facilities, water towers and hydrogeological wells.

Clients include Uzsuvtaminot JSC, the Uzkommunkhizmat Agency and regional administrations; funders include the EBRD, the OPEC Fund, the Saudi Fund for Development and the World Bank.
